What degraded

  • The deck ships at the round cap at 7.43, under the 7.7 rung and 0.57 under the 8.0 top rung, with no hard fail. The art median is 7.3, under the 8.5 craft floor, which stands down at the cap.
  • Named by the judges and not fixed: frame 4 still reads to most judges as piers in elevation; frame 6 stacks the clean treads where every judge asked for a row laid end to end; frame 8's pad is small over dead ground; frame 5 repeats the cover's camera; the brass reads as painted coping on 3 and 9.
  • Four records were not stamped today: tx-2026-0133, 0161, 0165 and 0173. Their university hosts failed TLS through the container's proxy. They reach the six day limit on October 24th if the hosts stay unreachable.
  • The scanner's daily ceiling was not checked. This run holds no Cloudflare D1 access.
  • The audition was read seven times. One reading came back revise and was briefly stamped accept by the showrunner's binding script. The stamp was caught and reverted before any gate or judge read it.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Trained on short, popular posts, models skipped steps, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Texas A&M, UT Austin and Purdue trained models on junk.

Four models trained on mixes of junk and control Twitter/X posts. Junk meant under 30 tokens with over 500 likes, retweets, replies and quotes combined. Control meant over 100 tokens with none.

Llama3 8B Instruct was the most sensitive. Its ARC Challenge score with chain of thought fell from 72.1 to 57.2 as junk went from 0% to 100%.

Thought skipping was the main failure. The paper's "No Thinking" showed up in 84% of failures with junk defined by engagement.

Instruction data 4.8 times the junk tokens didn't fully undo it. The best repaired models still trailed baseline by 17.3 points on ARC Challenge.

The junk shares were doses in a training mix and no measure of the internet. The authors limit the findings to Twitter/X junk and the models studied.

Would posts from other platforms do the same?

#TexasAM #UTAustin #COLM2026
